why: Это время подчёркивает сам процесс и его длительность: что-то началось в прошлом и продолжается до сих пор, либо только что закончилось и мы видим следы. По-русски: «Я работаю здесь три года», «Я весь день учусь», «Ты весь мокрый, ты бегал?»
formation: • Утверждение: have/has + been + V-ing: I have been working. She has been waiting.
• Отрицание: haven't / hasn't + been + V-ing: We haven't been sleeping well.
• Вопрос: Have/Has + подлежащее + been + V-ing?: Have you been studying?
• Краткие формы: I've been, he's been, they've been.
usage: 1. Процесс начался в прошлом и продолжается сейчас (часто с for и since).
• I have been learning English for two years. (Я учу английский два года.)
• He has been working since 8 a.m. (Он работает с 8 утра.)
2. Процесс только что закончился, и его результат виден сейчас.
• You look tired. Have you been running? (Ты выглядишь усталым. Ты бегал?)
• The ground is wet. It has been raining. (Земля мокрая. Шёл дождь.)
3. Вопрос How long ... ? про длительность процесса.
• How long have you been waiting? (Как долго ты ждёшь?)
• I have been going to the gym a lot lately. (Последнее время я много хожу в спортзал.)
Важно: Present Perfect Simple делает акцент на результате и количестве, Continuous на процессе.
• I have written three emails. (результат: три письма)
• I have been writing emails all morning. (процесс: всё утро)
signalWords: for, since, all day, all morning, how long, lately, recently.
Глаголы состояния (know, like, want, have = «иметь», be) в Continuous обычно не используем: I have known him for years (не have been knowing).
mistakes: ✗ I am waiting for you since 9 o'clock. → ✓ I have been waiting for you since 9 o'clock. С since и for нужно Perfect, а не Present Continuous.
✗ I have been wait for an hour. → ✓ I have been waiting for an hour. После been идёт форма -ing.
✗ I have been knowing him for years. → ✓ I have known him for years. Know не используется в Continuous.
✗ How long do you learn English? → ✓ How long have you been learning English? Русское настоящее время передаём Perfect Continuous.
✗ She has been finishing the report three times. → ✓ She has finished the report three times. Если есть количество или результат, ставим Simple.
remember: Have been + V-ing = «делаю уже какое-то время»; считаем результат (3 письма) в Simple, а процесс («всё утро») в Continuous.

exercises.instruction: Поставьте глагол в Present Perfect Continuous

items.prompt: I ___ (study) English for two years.
She ___ (work) here since January.
They ___ (wait) for the bus for twenty minutes.
It ___ (rain) all day.
We ___ (talk) for an hour.
He ___ (play) computer games since morning.
I ___ (learn) JavaScript for six months.
My brother ___ (live) in Warsaw since 2022.
How long (a) do you wait (b) have you been waiting for the doctor?
I (a) am working (b) have been working on this bug since lunch.
She (a) has been knowing (b) has known him for ten years.
You are out of breath. (a) Did you run (b) Have you been running?
He's tired because he (a) works (b) has been working all night.
I (a) have been having (b) have a headache right now.
We (a) have been living (b) live in this house since 2015.
They (a) have been (b) are been travelling for a month.
You have been learning Spanish. (Вопрос: How long ...?)
items.answer: How long have you been learning Spanish?

items.prompt: She has been sleeping well. (Отрицание)
They have been working today. (Вопрос: Have ...?)
I have been exercising. (Отрицание)
He has been driving since 6 a.m. (Вопрос: How long ...?)
items.answer: How long has he been driving?

items.prompt: We have been waiting for you. (Вопрос: Have ...?)
items.answer: Have you been waiting for us? / Have we been waiting for you?

items.prompt: It has been snowing. (Отрицание)
She has been studying all day. (Вопрос: Has ...?)
items.answer: Has she been studying all day?

exercises.instruction: Simple или Continuous? Поставьте глагол в правильную форму Present Perfect

items.prompt: I ___ (write) five emails this morning.
I ___ (write) emails all morning.
She ___ (read) this book for three hours.
She ___ (read) three books this month.
He ___ (paint) the kitchen. It's still wet.
They ___ (build) a new website since May.
I ___ (know) Peter for a long time.
We ___ (clean) the house all day.
Я учу английский уже полгода.
items.answer: I have been learning English for six months. / I have been learning English for half a year.

items.prompt: Как долго ты ждёшь?
items.answer: How long have you been waiting?

items.prompt: Весь день идёт снег.
items.answer: It has been snowing all day.

items.prompt: Он работает над этим проектом с марта.
items.answer: He has been working on this project since March.

items.prompt: Ты выглядишь уставшим. Ты не спал?
items.answer: You look tired. Haven't you been sleeping? / You look tired. Have you not been sleeping?

items.prompt: Мы целый час обсуждаем эту проблему.
items.answer: We have been discussing this problem for an hour.

items.prompt: Последнее время я мало сплю.
items.answer: I haven't been sleeping much lately. / I haven't been getting much sleep lately.

items.prompt: Она пишет код с девяти утра.
items.answer: She has been writing code since nine a.m. / She has been coding since nine a.m.
